$extensions.source: base.uber.com design system, uber.com production CSS, Uber brand book
$extensions.aesthetic: dark ride-share with monochromatic precision -- black canvas, white signal, luminance-based depth

surface.$description: Primary background -- pure black canvas, the brand's emotional foundation

surface-subtle.$description: Elevated dark surface -- cards, panels, navigation overlays

surface-raised.$description: Second-tier elevation -- modals, popovers, active card states

surface-light.$description: Light-mode variant surface -- app screens, maps, content areas

surface-light-subtle.$description: Light-mode secondary surface -- sidebar backgrounds, input fields

accent.$description: Primary accent -- white on black, the only chromatic signal on dark surfaces

accent-hover.$description: Accent hover state -- slightly dimmed white

text-primary.$description: Primary text on dark -- pure white for headings and body

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text on dark -- descriptions, metadata, inactive nav

text-tertiary.$description: Tertiary text on dark -- timestamps, fine print, disabled states

text-on-accent.$description: Text on white accent buttons -- pure black

uber-green.$description: Uber Eats green -- sub-brand accent, success states

uber-blue.$description: Uber Freight blue -- focus rings, link highlights, sub-brand accent

success.$description: Success/positive state -- trip confirmed, payment processed

border-dark.$description: Border on dark surfaces -- barely visible white edge

border-dark-prominent.$description: Prominent border on dark -- dividers, active states

font-display.$value: "Uber Move", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-display.$description: Display/heading font -- Uber Move for large type (headings, hero, metrics)

font-body.$value: "Uber Move Text", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-body.$description: Body/text font -- Uber Move Text optimized for smaller sizes

scale-display.$description: Display -- hero headlines, landing page primary text

scale-title.$description: Title -- card headings, modal titles, feature names

scale-subtitle.$description: Subtitle -- subheadings, nav items, emphasized body

line-height-tight.$description: Tight -- display and heading text, maximizes impact

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Tight tracking -- display sizes (52px+) for visual density

letter-spacing-normal.$description: Normal tracking -- body and title sizes

weight-medium.$description: Medium -- headings, emphasis, Uber Move display weight

weight-bold.$description: Bold -- strong emphasis, metric values, hero headlines

unit.$description: Base unit -- Uber uses a strict 4px grid

2xs.$description: Micro -- icon-to-label gap, tight inline spacing

xs.$description: Extra small -- inner padding, compact elements

sm.$description: Small -- button padding vertical, list item gaps

md.$description: Medium -- standard component padding, card body gaps

lg.$description: Large -- section inner padding, card padding

xl.$description: Extra large -- card padding generous, between-component gaps

2xl.$description: Double extra large -- section dividers, hero inner spacing

section-gap.$description: Section spacing -- between major page sections (80-120px range)

section-padding.$description: Section padding -- vertical / horizontal for desktop sections

container-narrow.$description: Narrow container -- text-heavy content, pricing cards

radius-standard.$description: Standard -- buttons, cards, inputs (Uber's primary radius)

radius-lg.$description: Large -- featured cards, modals, hero containers

radius-xl.$description: Extra large -- prominent panels, bottom sheets

radius-pill.$description: Pill -- tags, status badges, toggle switches

level-0.$description: Flat -- no elevation, flush with surface

level-1-dark.$description: Subtle luminance border -- card edges on dark, barely visible glow

level-2-dark.$description: Elevated luminance -- modals, dropdowns, floating panels on dark

level-1-light.$description: Standard elevation on light -- cards, panels

level-2-light.$description: Deep elevation on light -- modals, dropdowns

duration-micro.$description: Micro -- hover state changes, opacity shifts

duration-fast.$description: Fast -- button presses, toggle switches, small interactions

duration-normal.$description: Normal -- page transitions, card reveals, panel slides

easing-default.$description: Ease-out -- Uber's default, feels direct and confident

reduced-duration.$description: Near-zero duration for prefers-reduced-motion. Applied via media query.

reduced-easing.$description: Linear easing for reduced motion -- no spring/bounce.
